title: Acting approver
intro: Name someone to act for you while you are on leave or away. During that time new approval tasks that come to you go to them. Both of you can decide; whoever acts first decides.
positionsLine: The authority you can hand over comes from {positions}
noPosition: You hold no position with approval authority, so there is nothing to hand over. If this is wrong, contact your organization admin.
periodHint: Starts at 00:00 on the first day and ends when the last day ends, Thai time
coverageAll: Every kind of approval task of your positions
coverageAllHint: Includes approving DOA changes and authority changes; the separation-of-duties checks still apply
maxAmountHint: Leave blank for no cap, still within your position's authority. With a cap, tasks without an amount, such as DOA changes, do not go to the acting approver.
created: Acting approver named: {name} acts for you {period}
givenEmpty: Nobody acts for you yet. Before leave or time away, name an acting approver with the form on this page; new approval tasks then go to them for that time.
receivedEmpty: You do not act for anyone now. When someone names you, it shows here and you are told.
viaAuthorityChange: Set by an approved authority change
revokeConfirm: Confirm the cancellation: new approval tasks come back to you at once; tasks already sent to the acting approver stay with them
revoked: Acting approver cancelled; new approval tasks come to you

errors.DELEGATE: Choose the acting approver from the list first
errors.FIRST_DAY: Enter a real date as the first day
errors.PAST_FIRST_DAY: The first day must be today or later
errors.LAST_DAY: Enter a real date as the last day
errors.INVALID_PERIOD: The last day cannot be before the first day
errors.AMOUNT: Enter the cap in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 10000 or 10,000.50
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: The cap must be above 0 baht
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.TYPES: Choose at least one kind of approval task, or choose every kind
errors.NOTHING_TO_DELEGATE: You hold no position with approval authority in that time, so there is nothing to hand over
errors.OVERLAPPING_DELEGATION: These days overlap an acting approver you already named; cancel that one or choose other days
errors.SELF_DELEGATION: You cannot act for yourself; choose someone else
errors.DELEGATE_NOT_ACTIVE: The acting approver must be an active member; choose someone else
errors.CONFIRM: Tick the confirmation box before cancelling
errors.STATE: This acting approver has ended or was cancelled already; reload the page to see the latest state
errors.NOT_FOUND: This acting approver was not found; reload the page and try again
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this; you can only name or cancel your own acting approver
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and repeat this action.
errors.BUSY: Another change of yours is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INPUT: Some details are missing or wrong. Check the fields and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps failing, give this reference to your organization admin.
errors.FAILED: It was not saved. Try again.
